notes.title: Update Ver2.12
notes.content:
Update Announcement:

We have made changes to the game to decrease the rate at which time passes during the preparation phase. Additionally, all technology research and resource acquisition will now synchronize with the reduced base time rate. This adjustment aims to significantly reduce the learning curve for new players without compromising the overall difficulty of the game.

notes.title: Version Update 2.11
notes.content:
1.Added pause and acceleration indicator buttons. Pressing the spacebar can pause the game.
2.Fixed a text error in the description of the Elemental Mage in the technology section.

notes.title: Version Update v2.09
notes.content:
1.The talents of the Archmage's Elemental series will now be chosen at level six, eliminating any conflicts.
2.A new level five technology, Elemental Mage, has been added to the tech tree.
3.A legendary equipment for the Mage class has been added.
4.A mythic equipment for the Mage class has been added.

notes.title: Version Update v2.08
notes.content:
1.Improved the beginner tutorial.

2.Enhanced the display of the technology tree interface.

notes.title: Version Update v2.06
notes.content:
[b]Update Content:[/b]

1.Significantly increased the base drop rate of legendary equipment on normal and hard difficulty.
2.Adjusted the initial resources on hard difficulty.
3.Slightly increased the difficulty of level 34 in hell mode.
4.Windowed mode now supports resolution adjustment.

notes.title: Official Version Release
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continuous support and attention to our game! We are excited to announce that after a long period of development and testing, the official version update of our game is now ready!

In this official version update, we have listened to the feedback and suggestions from players and made numerous optimizations and improvements.

Update Highlights:

1.New: Hell difficulty, where a boss appears every 10 levels. Defeating the boss will reward you with unique prizes.

2.New: Academic Center, accessed by clicking the icon on the top right of the game screen. In the Academic Center, you can conduct academic research by consuming a large amount of basic materials.

3.New: Bloodstone Essence Workshop, where legendary equipment can be upgraded to mythical equipment using Bloodstone.

4.New: Added 8 new monsters and 7 unique bosses.

5.New: Added a large number of unique equipment.

6.Each Hell boss requires different strategies. Refer to the encyclopedia for detailed information on monsters.

7.The drop rate of legendary equipment has been changed to dynamic drop rate, gradually increasing as you progress through the levels until the legendary equipment is dropped, and then resetting.

8.During the preparation phase, you can now equip soldiers and give orders to logistics units while paused.

If you are unable to launch the game, please exit the Steam client and restart it.

In addition to the new content, we have also fixed some issues and bugs from previous versions, improving the overall performance and smoothness of the game. We are committed to providing you with a better gaming experience.

To celebrate the launch of the official version, we would like to share an exciting news with you. After careful consideration, we have decided to lower the price of the game to better respond to the expectations and feedback from players.

Thank you for your patience and support for our game. We are well aware that without your support, we would not have made such great progress. We will continue to work hard and bring you more exciting updates and content.

Please update the game now and enjoy our official version! We look forward to your feedback and suggestions to help us continuously improve and enhance the game.

Have a great time playing!

notes.title: Version Update - ver1.35
notes.content:
1.New character: Wizard
2.New game difficulty: Normal

notes.title: Version Update ver. 1.3
notes.content:
UI Updates:

1、The kitchen UI has been updated.
2、The main page UI has been updated.
3、The soldier UI in the battle preparation phase has been updated.

Bug Fixes:

1、Fixed an issue where the turn time could be reset under certain circumstances.
2、Fixed text descriptions for some talents in the English version.

notes.title: Version update ver. 1.27
notes.content:
1、Updated the UI of the Barracks.

2、Updated the UI of the Blacksmith.

3、Fixed description errors in the cutscene texts

notes.title: Version Update ver.1.26
notes.content:
1、Updated the UI of the transition page from preparation to battle: Added tips on levels and enemy units.
2、Added tips for game basic structures.
3、Added window mode in the settings.
4、Fixed the missing text for Berserker's armor penetration, now the attributes of the Berserker will be correctly displayed in the encyclopedia and war camp.
5、Fixed the issue of incorrect display of legendary equipment in the encyclopedia during the game.

notes.title: Version Update ver.1.24
notes.content:
1、New Addition: Beginner's Tutorial, accessible through the main menu.
2、New Addition: Added a settings button on the main page, now you can adjust the volume from the main page.
3、Improved the UI of logistics unit avatars.

notes.title: Version Update ver.1.23
notes.content:
1、Optimized the UI of character avatars during the preparation phase.
2、Added operation prompts for character avatars: Press the number keys 1 and 2 to switch between characters.
3、Fixed the description error of the character "Holy Blade - Blue Crystal" in the English environment.
4、Fixed the issue where the game resolution was incorrect after adjusting the computer's resolution.

notes.title: Version update ver.1.2
notes.content:
1、Costume System: The appearance of soldiers will no longer be fixed. When wearing legendary equipment or weapons, the soldiers' appearance will be more in line with the equipped items.
2、When an archer equips a knight's axe, they will no longer shoot arrows but instead throw flying axes.
3、Optimized the UI of the loot interface.
4、Berserkers are no longer affected by the attack speed limit.
5、The current equipment count in the blacksmith shop now includes high-level equipment.

[b][Talent Adjustments][/b]
Chef Talent - Brewing: The effect of doubling the basic attack speed with a 30% chance when attacking has been adjusted to increase the attack speed by 50%.

notes.title: 8.30Update
notes.content:
1.Archers have been removed from the list of playable classes for the Black Blade.
2.The Black Blade has been enhanced with a 10% lifesteal ability.
3.The early difficulty has been lowered, with two skeleton mages removed from the sixth level.
4.The attack power of the Hidden Blade has been increased from 8 to 10.
